app.description: A fully accessible IDE for dyslexic and neurodivergent learners.
app.title: AccessibleIDE - Code comfortably
brand.name: AccessibleIDE
colours.contrast_help: Extra high pushes the text and the background further apart. Try it if words blend together.
config.error_colour: {0} must be a colour like #1a1a1a, or left empty to use the theme colour.
config.error_on_off: {0} has to be switched on or off.

editor.label: Python code editor
error.access_code_prompt: This site is protected. Enter the access code:
error.access_code_run: This site is protected. Enter the access code to run code.
error.blocked_general: This code uses a feature that is not allowed in the web version. Try simpler code, or use the desktop app for full Python.
error.blocked_import: This code uses a feature that is not allowed in the web version (importing "{0}"). Try simpler code, or use the desktop app for full Python.
error.timeout: Code timed out (10 second limit). Check for infinite loops.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.too_many_requests: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
focus.fade_help: Only used when Focus mode is set to fade the other lines.
focus.hint: Focus mode narrows what you see, so it is easier to follow one spot at a time.
footer.text: AccessibleIDE - built with empathy for dyslexic and neurodivergent learners.
language.help: This changes the words in AccessibleIDE. Your code stays the same.
language.label: Language
motion.help: Turning this on stops the buttons, switches and panels moving. Nothing disappears, it just arrives straight away.
motion.hint: Movement is extra. Turning it off never changes what the app does, only how quickly things arrive.
motion.label: Reduce motion
nav.save_title: Save your code to a file
nav.settings_title: Change how the editor looks and sounds
output.runner_unreachable: Could not reach the code runner.
output.server_down: The server is not responding. Please try again.
output.title: Output
python.AttributeError: You're trying to use an attribute or method that doesn't exist on this object.
python.FileNotFoundError: The file you're trying to open doesn't exist.
python.ImportError: Python can't find the module you're trying to import.
python.IndentationError: Indentation error. Python uses spaces to group code blocks. Make sure your indentation is consistent.
python.IndexError: You're trying to access an index that doesn't exist in a list or string.
python.KeyError: You're trying to access a dictionary key that doesn't exist.
python.MemoryError: Your program ran out of memory.
python.ModuleNotFoundError: The module you're trying to import isn't installed.
python.NameError: You're using a variable or function name that hasn't been defined yet.
python.PermissionError: You don't have permission to access this file.
python.RecursionError: Your function is calling itself too many times (infinite recursion).
python.SyntaxError: There's a syntax error in your code. Check for missing parentheses, brackets, or quotes.
python.TypeError: You're trying to do something with the wrong type of data (like adding text to a number).
python.ValueError: A function received a value of the right type but an inappropriate value.
python.ZeroDivisionError: You're dividing by zero, which isn't allowed.
reading.hint: These change how the code looks. Nothing here needs a restart.
reading.letter_spacing_help: Extra space between letters. Some readers find a little more easier to track.
reading.line_height_help: How much space between lines. More space can make text easier to follow.
settings.not_saved: Changed for now. It will not be remembered until the app is back online.
settings.save_failed: That setting could not be saved.
settings.title: Settings
speak.click: Read a label when I click it
speak.click_help: Clicking a button, a heading or a label says what it is. Your code and the results window are left alone, so running your program still behaves normally.
speak.demo: This is how your code results will sound when they are read aloud.
speak.help: When this is on, AccessibleIDE reads the output and any error message out loud after you run your code.
speak.hover_all: Everything, including the text on the page
speak.hover_delay_help: A short pause before each one. A longer wait means hovering only speaks when you rest on something, rather than every time the pointer passes over it.
speak.hover_scope_help: How much of the screen is worth reading out loud. This sits alongside your own screen reader rather than replacing it.
speak.rate_help: Around 1 is a normal speaking pace. Below 1 is slower.
speak.voice_gender_help: Your computer does not say which voices are male or female, so this is a best guess made from the voice names. Picking a voice yourself above overrides it, and the app uses whatever is installed on this computer.
speak.voice_help: The voices here come from your computer and Windows. Not every computer has the same ones.
try.error_not_hex: That is not a colour. Use # followed by 3 or 6 letters or digits, like #ffd93d.
try.hex_help: Starts with a #, then 3 or 6 letters or digits, like #ffd93d. Leave it empty to go back to the theme colour.
try.hint: See how your font and colour look before you keep them. Everything here is saved straight away.
try.nudge_help: If a colour would be hard to read on your theme, the app nudges it until it is easy to read again.
try.picker_label: Pick a colour with the colour picker
try.sample_default: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
try.sample_help: Change the words to anything you like. The preview below follows along.
try.status_nudged: On this theme it was lightened or darkened to {0} so it stays easy to read.
try.swatch_help: Pick a square, or type any colour code below.
try.system_font: {0} comes from your computer. If it does not show, an included font will be used instead.
update.auto_check_help: The app looks once a day when you open it. It only tells you a new version exists; you decide what happens next.
update.check_help: Ask for a new version straight away, whether or not the automatic check is on.
update.error_bad_manifest: The update information could not be read, so nothing was changed.
update.error_bad_url: The download address was not accepted, so nothing was downloaded.
update.error_bad_version: The version number in the update information could not be read.
update.error_checked_recently: Already checked a little while ago.
update.error_checksum: The downloaded file was not what was expected, so it was discarded and nothing was changed.
update.error_download_failed: The download did not finish, so nothing was changed.
update.error_missing_build: The new version's file is missing.
update.error_network: Could not reach GitHub to check for updates. Your work is unaffected.
update.error_no_checksum: The new version came without a safety check, so it was not downloaded.
update.error_not_applicable: Updates only apply to the downloaded desktop app.
update.error_prepare: The update could not be prepared. Close the app and try again.
update.error_start: The update could not be started. Close the app and try again.
update.error_too_large: The file is bigger than expected, so it was not downloaded.
update.error_unknown: The update check did not work. Nothing was changed.
update.hint: New versions are published on GitHub. Nothing is downloaded or changed without your asking.
update.status_current: You are on the newest version ({0}).
update.status_not_applicable: This is the website version, so it updates by itself when the site is updated.
update.status_off: Automatic checking is off. You can still ask at any time.
